lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: O-oh! That happened to me too, when I first came out of the water.

lines: You could've warned me this was going to happen!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I didn't know it would happen again!

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: Neither did I... But, um, you get used to walking. Mostly.

lines: Everything's so much taller from up here...

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: It's okay if you're a little scared. I was too.

lines: I'm NOT scared. I just— need a second.
So what am I supposed to do now?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You could stay at the townhouse! We can get you a room.

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: There's space for you! It's actually pretty nice.

lines: Hmph. Fine. Just until I figure this out.
I can find a room by myself, you know.
